patch.value: Commander usage refusals omit token_accounting even when --token-accounting is parsed

The CLI attaches token_accounting to successful commands and runtime PmCliError failures, but Commander usage failures such as an unknown option render before the accounting attachment path. A caller explicitly requesting --json --token-accounting therefore receives no receipt. The agent-task transcript gate currently measures these refusals independently and labels that boundary; the CLI should eventually make the self-reported contract uniform without changing exit semantics.

Commander JSON usage errors attach the same bounded token_accounting receipt when requested; accounting-off bytes remain unchanged; CLI order and alias forms behave identically; focused process tests and the golden transcript switch from independent_transport to self_reported.
